subject: POC gating playbook & ownership commitments — network keys, peering, allowlist
messages:
From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@maplebio.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>; ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@maplebio.com
Date: Sat, 09 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — environment gating and credentials (next steps)

Hi Monica / Ben —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We want to lock the MAP so our infra team can begin the environment setup this week. High level asks:

- Org setup: we need an org-level role mapping so our SSO admin can federate access and create service accounts.
- API keys: short-lived API keys for eval traffic, and guidance on rotation/KMS.
- IP allowlist: a concrete CIDR list to add to our perimeter — we'll also need expected egress IPs for callbacks.
- VPC peering: steps and a contact for peering handoff (we do peering requests through our cloud infra queue).

Can you send a MAP-style checklist with owners and target dates? We plan to start pre-reqs on Monday. Also, attaching our internal readiness checklist for visibility.

Thanks,
Sylvia Kim
Head of Platform, Maple Bio
attachment: maple_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@maplebio.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — environment gating and credentials (MAP draft attached)

Sylvia —

Appreciate the clear list. I've drafted a short MAP (attached) that breaks the items into ownerable tasks and a suggested 2-week close timeline. Highlights below:

1) Org & access
   - Owner: monica_patel (Redwood SE) / Sylvia (Maple SSO)
   - Action: Exchange SAML metadata + create Redwood service account in Maple org
   - Target: 2 business days after MAP signoff

2) API keys & token policy
   - Owner: rishi_malhotra (Redwood infra)
   - Action: Provide scoped API key provisioning flow, example key rotation using KMS, tradeoffs for short-lived vs static keys
   - Target: Keys issued within 3 business days of service account creation

3) IP allowlist & callback IPs
   - Owner: ben_carter (Redwood sales-eng) for initial CIDR list; ops@maplebio.com to implement
   - Action: Confirm inbound and expected outbound IPs for webhook/callback traffic
   - Target: CIDR list sent within 24 hours of MAP signoff

4) VPC peering
   - Owner: tessa_morgan (Redwood cloud eng) / Maple infra ops contact
   - Action: Exchange VPC IDs, route table entries, and approve peering request. We can open the request once org/service account is provisioned.
   - Target: Peering request opened within 5 business days

I attached the MAP draft (20270109-map-draft.xlsx) and a draft SLA redline so your legal/procurement can glance before we finalize. Two asks from our side:

- Can Maple confirm who on ops will own peering tickets and the expected SLA for accepting peering?
- Can you confirm whether Maple requires private connectivity for all traffic or just control-plane callbacks?

If that works, I suggest we aim to sign the MAP by Tuesday and start the org/service-account handoff on Wednesday.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mobile: (415) 555-0199
attachment: 20270109-map-draft.xlsx (xlsx); map-sla-redline.pdf (pdf)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@maplebio.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — procurement notes and DocuSign window

Looping in a quick procurement note so we don't block the timeline:

- MAP signoff constitutes go-ahead for POC credentials provisioning. Our standard POC addendum covers data usage, retention (30 days), and logging. See attached redline summary.
- If Maple needs an SOW or a purchase order, we can start DocuSign on Tuesday; typical turnaround is 48–72 hours for signature from mid-market customers.

From a network perspective I confirm Redwood will provide the following as part of the POC:
  - Scoped API keys (token-based)
  - Example KMS rotation snippet and recommended rotation cadence
  - Static egress IPs for callback (list to follow in a separate note)

I'll send the CIDR list by EOD today. Monica, flag anything we should call out in procurement (SLA add-on, extended retention) so I can include it in DocuSign.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
attachment: procurement-redline-summary.txt (txt)
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@maplebio.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC gating playbook & ownership commitments — next steps and commitments

Sylvia —

Thanks for the quick replies and for confirming. Recap + firmed commitments:

- MAP signoff: target Tue 2027-01-12 COB (we can accept confirmation by reply). Once you confirm, Rishi will provision a scoped service account and issue test API keys (short-lived token example).
- IP allowlist: Ben to send static egress/callback IPs by EOD today — ops@maplebio.com will use that to open firewall rules.
- VPC peering: Tessa will send the peering checklist (required fields: VPC ID, region, route table IDs, desired CIDR ranges) and a sample peering request template. We recommend opening your cloud ticket once service-account SAML metadata is exchanged.

Next-step calendar invites I'll send after MAP signoff:
  - Handoff session (30 min): Org SAML + service-account exchange (owner: Monica)
  - Network sync (30 min): peering and firewall rules (owner: Tessa)
  - Validation call (30 min): test key issuance and simple echo test (owner: Rishi)

If Maple confirms signoff in this thread, we'll proceed Wednesday morning with provisioning. Happy to adapt targets if you need more runway.

Thanks,
Monica
